items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, Sonny Greer took sick... But he's a most recuperative guy I ever saw in my life.

ctx.x: Well, Sonny was sick at that time.

Yeah, Sonny Greer took sick. Well, he -- at that time he used to drink quite a lot. But -- and then he was very sickly and after that he got on the road. But he's a most recuperative guy I ever saw in my life.
I saw him a couple of years ago in New York, playing with this young piano player who's an Ellington --
